resume: GHOULBOX is a dark, medieval, fantasy dungeon synth firmware, a fork of Felucca: the FM-1 boots into a ready-to-play scene (D minor, 72 BPM), with 59 sounds including a hurdy-gurdy.

commandes.role: Held at power-on, starts USB rescue mode.
TAPE page: worn cassette, CRSH, cave ambience (AMB) and torch crackle (CRKL).
Sound settings; the RING page (drones that ring during silences) comes after DRONE and WHEEL.
Held, drone lock (see gestures); with SELECT, tempo.
Held, opens the menu (SYSTEM, MIDI, CONTROL). Pressed on HOME, moves to MIXER, CLOCK, KEYS then DREAM.
Opens the phrases (PHRASES); held after FREEZE, cancels the freeze.
Sequencer; held then F4 (FREEZE), freezes the last DREAM pass into the chosen track.
With COUP on CRANK on a GURDY track, becomes the crank: the faster you turn, the louder and brighter.

gestes: GLO held + F#4, G#4, A#4 or C#5: locks tracks 1 to 4, the chord played keeps sounding after release.
SEQ held + F4: FREEZE, the track's steps become what the last DREAM pass played.
OCT- held at power-on: USB rescue mode.

modes.texte: Page after MIXER, CLOCK and KEYS (presses of HOME). Choose a MOOD and press a key: the FM-1 composes a slow piece in that key for the four tracks. EVOL makes it evolve on its own; DENS sets the density, DRFT the frequency of changes. It replaces the patterns of the four tracks (it asks first).
MENU > SYSTEM > SCENE chooses what the FM-1 plays at power-on: DUNGEON (default), CRYPT, TAVERN, CHAPEL or BLANK.

a_savoir: The README doesn't describe the basic controls inherited from Felucca (sequencer, menu, engines): it refers to the Felucca README.
